summary: Set on the fringe of the Lake District National Park, in well run holiday village with excellent onsite facilities and potential for a lucrative holiday letting property, a great opportunity to acquire a fully equipped, one-bedroom, maisonette apartment with balcony & wonderful open aspect views.
description:
Conveniently positioned between Keswick and Penrith, with easy access to the Ullswater Valley and Northern Fells, Whitbarrow Village is a beautifully presented and maintained, fully enclosed holiday village providing luxury self-catering accommodation, with a host of leisure facilities and amenities on site.

Offered for sale fully furnished, with accommodation over two floors, the living space comprises an open plan kitchen, living, dining room, with pull out sofa bed providing additional sleeping space, which leads to a balcony with open rural views to the rear. Adjacent is a 4 piece bathroom.

The upper floor comprises a double bedroom with windows to the front and rear elevations and built in storage.

Having been used privately by our clients, the option exists for it to become an excellent income generating rental unit.

We understand that the site owners can assist with operating the property as a business, please enquire for further details.

Directions From Junction 40 of the M6, take the A66 towards Keswick. After approximately 7 Miles tale the right turn by the Sportsman’s Inn where there are brown and white signs to Whitbarrow Village, off the main road. In the development, the apartment is adjacent to the main reception. PLEASE NOTE - VIEWING IS STRICTLY BY APPOINTMENT ONLY

Services Material Information Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • Vehicle parking is in a communal car park • Please note, there is no right of permanent occupation

Tenure: Leasehold, with 982 years remaining of a 999 year lease granted in June 2008. There is an annual combined ground rent and service charge of £3,340.
